"""Freeze source gates, reproduce July controls, then test two K4 folds."""
from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import re
import subprocess
import time

from engine.reverse_engineer import Crib
from engine.solvers.enigma import EnigmaMachine
from engine.solvers.k4_attempt import K4_CIPHERTEXT
from engine.solvers.persona_hallucinogens import investigate_hallucinogens
from tests.test_enigma_crib_search import _oracle

ROOT = Path.cwd()
WORK = ROOT / "work/tractable-open-attempt-2026-10-03"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "docs/logs/tractable-open-attempt-2026-10-03.json"


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


class Text(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.parts = []
        self.hidden = 0

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ("script", "style"):
            self.hidden += 1

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ("script", "style"):
            self.hidden -= 1

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.hidden:
            self.parts.append(data)


def text(name):
    parser = Text()
    parser.feed((WORK / (name + ".html")).read_text())
    return " ".join(parser.parts)


sources = json.loads((WORK / "sources.json").read_text())
for source in sources:
    suffix = ".pdf" if source["id"].endswith("scan") else ".html"
    assert digest(WORK / (source["id"] + suffix)) == source["sha256"]

code_paths = (
    "engine/solvers/persona_hallucinogens.py", "engine/persona_solver_common.py",
    "engine/solvers/affine.py", "engine/language.py", "engine/data/english.txt",
    "engine/alphabet.py", "engine/reverse_engineer.py", "engine/solvers/enigma.py",
    "engine/solvers/k4_attempt.py", "tests/test_enigma_crib_search.py",
    "work/tractable-open-attempt-2026-10-03/run_attempt.py",
)
hashes_before = {path: digest(ROOT / path) for path in code_paths}
git_head = subprocess.check_output(("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"), text=True, timeout=5).strip()
git_status = subprocess.check_output(("git", "status", "--short"), text=True, timeout=5).splitlines()
started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
clock_start = time.perf_counter()

master_raw = (WORK / "master.html").read_text()
assert "Status on: 30 September 2026" in master_raw
open_entries = []
for designator in ("EHSTQ", "RXPSB", "KLJBO", "LXACA", "JBIYH"):
    mark = next(match.group(1) for match in re.finditer(r"<mark>(.*?)</mark>", master_raw, re.S)
                if designator in match.group(1))
    parser = Text()
    parser.feed(mark)
    row = " ".join(" ".join(parser.parts).split())
    assert "Broken" not in row
    open_entries.append({"designator": designator, "master_row": row,
                         "source_id": "master", "status_date": "2026-09-30",
                         "status": "highlighted_open_in_publisher_master_list"})

july_key_text = text("july-keys")
other_key_text = text("june-oct-keys")
july_dates = re.findall(r"Enigma keys for\s+(\d{2}\.\d{2}\.1941)", july_key_text)
other_dates = re.findall(r"Enigma keys for\s+(\d{2}\.\d{2}\.1941)", other_key_text)
assert july_dates
assert other_dates
for date in ("03.07.1941", "04.07.1941", "20.07.1941"):
    assert date not in july_dates
for date in ("22.06.1941", "28.06.1941"):
    assert date not in other_dates

LXACA = "ZIXAGNQRKOHBPNKXRLFU"
JBIYH = "NVYMIVLOGGKTDKKOYXWRDLBHRRZYPILVVXOGBEFXAXCWBNGILRWARXO"
KLJBO = "YNGZOWCIRESGVEVKFGCNXDTLIKINLBOYL?NTNYBD?NWK?A?UVV"

assert len(JBIYH) == 55
assert len(KLJBO) == 50 and KLJBO.count("?") == 4
targets = [

    {"designator": "JBIYH", "number": 242, "received_date": "1941-07-20",

     "eligibility": "no_source_backed_applicable_daily_key",
     "missing_evidence": "July 20 rotor order, reflector, rings and plugboard; a solved same-network July 20 Enigma control.",

     "source_ids": ["master", "july-messages", "july-keys", "jbiyh-scan", "supplement"],

     "ciphertext": KLJBO, "ciphertext_slots": 50,

    {"designator": "EHSTQ", "number": 3, "received_date": "1941-06-22",

    {"designator": "RXPSB", "number": 53, "received_date": "1941-06-28",
     "publisher_master_body_length": 109, "actual_transcribed_slots": 107,
     "eligibility": "no_source_backed_applicable_daily_key",
     "missing_evidence": "Applicable June 28 settings, or affirmative proof of another enciphering date/network; reconciliation of the 109 versus 107 body-slot discrepancy.",
     "reason": "The earlier source audit found two explicit gaps but no June 28 key. Same-call-sign Nr51 is explicitly enciphered on June 27 and cannot establish the target date.",
     "prior_audit": "docs/logs/enigma-open-target-2026-10-03.json",
     "source_ids": ["master", "army-messages", "june-oct-keys"]},
]

settings = {"rotors": ("III", "V", "IV"), "reflector": "B", "rings": "WHJ",
            "plugboard": tuple("BI CW EQ FX HZ JN KY MT OV PR".split())}
plugs = tuple(tuple(pair) for pair in settings["plugboard"])
controls = []
vectors = (
    (99, "XTMSY", "QCB", "NSR", "SIM", "SOM",
     "TWDAZ YHQMH TJWVB DYLIS JUWPL ZELIS GDPHR HJUYH XLBGH PGWZH WVRYG TGLXP EWPHA PGOII VDBEN MGMAG HRHUD DIFHF MLYOD VLEBT ZTHAK GPUCM QMAEN SPNOS XXSKK TIDTS OIUZL YAWEJ NXLEV ZHZVZ OMDZN W"),
    (101, "DEROP", "AIK", "SUD", "WER", "WLN",
     "AQDEG MQTRR JYMHB ITNRQ OXTCS NFSLV NPDLR VDRRP TZXFR CWMID YQDSE XLJIK AKCWG MIQCP NEQEV DNMSL DSSWI OKEIB KPYJD PRNKH KSYNO OMGZE NLBCN SLHNX OCSEB LWEBM JDRSF GJQVH FQXTU BWYFR BYKYP LCEDF JILLV YKQTI KNPDD TDO"),
)
engine_calls = 0
oracle_calls = 0
for number, designator, indicator_start, indicator_cipher, expected_start, expected_stop, grouped in vectors:
    cipher = "".join(grouped.split())
    machine = EnigmaMachine(settings["rotors"], "B", "WHJ", indicator_start, plugs)
    decoded_start = machine.process(indicator_cipher)
    engine_calls += 1
    oracle_start = _oracle(indicator_cipher, indicator_start, rotors=settings["rotors"], rings="WHJ", plugs=plugs)
    oracle_calls += 1
    assert decoded_start == oracle_start == expected_start
    machine = EnigmaMachine(settings["rotors"], "B", "WHJ", decoded_start, plugs)
    raw_plaintext = machine.process(cipher)
    engine_calls += 1
    oracle_plaintext = _oracle(cipher, decoded_start, rotors=settings["rotors"], rings="WHJ", plugs=plugs)
    oracle_calls += 1
    assert raw_plaintext == oracle_plaintext
    assert machine.windows() == expected_stop
    replay = EnigmaMachine(settings["rotors"], "B", "WHJ", decoded_start, plugs).process(raw_plaintext)
    engine_calls += 1
    oracle_replay = _oracle(raw_plaintext, decoded_start, rotors=settings["rotors"], rings="WHJ", plugs=plugs)
    oracle_calls += 1
    assert replay == oracle_replay == cipher
    controls.append({"number": number, "designator": designator, "key_date": "1941-07-05",
                     "settings": settings, "indicator_start": indicator_start, "indicator_cipher": indicator_cipher,
                     "published_start": expected_start, "actual_start": decoded_start,
                     "published_stop": expected_stop, "actual_stop": machine.windows(),
                     "ciphertext": cipher, "ciphertext_length": len(cipher),
                     "raw_machine_output": raw_plaintext,
                     "raw_output_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw_plaintext.encode("ascii")).hexdigest(),
                     "arithmetic_oracle_agrees": True, "full_ciphertext_replay_matches": True,
                     "independent_full_plaintext_reference_found": False,
                     "scope": "Published indicator and stop control plus transform consistency; raw garbles are not rewritten.",
                     "source_ids": ["july-messages", "july-keys", "master"]})

prospective = EnigmaMachine(settings["rotors"], "B", "WHJ", "OGD", plugs).process("PKN")
engine_calls += 1
prospective_oracle = _oracle("PKN", "OGD", rotors=settings["rotors"], rings="WHJ", plugs=plugs)
oracle_calls += 1
assert prospective == prospective_oracle == "LXI"
negative_transfer = {"target": "LXACA", "indicator_start": "OGD", "indicator_cipher": "PKN",
                     "output_under_july5_settings": prospective,
                     "arithmetic_oracle_agrees": True, "eligible_key": False,
                     "reason": "Decoding any indicator under a supplied key does not validate that key's date/network. The publisher explicitly rejects July 5 for LXACA; no target-body search was run."}

assert len(K4_CIPHERTEXT) == 97
assert hashlib.sha256(K4_CIPHERTEXT.encode("ascii")).hexdigest() == "eea813570c7f1fd3b34674e47b5c3da8948026f5cefee612a0b38ffaa515ceab"
for name in ("cia-kryptos", "elonka-transcript"):
    rendered = text(name)
    index = rendered.index("OBKR")
    tail = "".join(letter for letter in rendered[index:] if letter in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ")[:97]
    assert tail == K4_CIPHERTEXT
assert K4_CIPHERTEXT[25:34] == "QQPRNGKSS"
assert K4_CIPHERTEXT[63:74] == "NYPVTTMZFPK"

folds = []
for train, heldout in ((Crib(25, "NORTHEAST"), Crib(63, "BERLINCLOCK")),
                       (Crib(63, "BERLINCLOCK"), Crib(25, "NORTHEAST"))):

    report = investigate_hallucinogens(K4_CIPHERTEXT, cribs=(train,),

    assert report["bounds"]["total_requested_checks"] == 10608
    assert report["claimed_plaintext"] is None and not report["correctness_known"]
    assert report["accepted_unique_plaintexts"] == 0 and not report["candidates"]
    assert report["crib_rejections"] == 5000
    counts = [item["checks"] for item in report["transform_checks"]]
    assert sum(counts) == 5000 and max(counts) - min(counts) == 1

    folds.append({"tool_name": "persona-hallucinogens", "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
                  "training_cribs": [{"offset": train.offset, "plaintext": train.plaintext}],
                  "heldout_cribs": [{"offset": heldout.offset, "plaintext": heldout.plaintext}],
